load_model_maws: load a MAWS vision-language model wrapped in WrapModel and set to eval mode on the specified device
get_transform_maws: get a video preprocessing transform pipeline that normalizes pixels, resizes to 224, and center crops
create_modelconfig_maws: create a ModelConfig dataclass with model_name, base_model, and input_type for MAWS model configuration
wrap_model_forward: wrap a MAWS model in WrapModel to encode video frames as image embeddings via encode_images
norm_pixels_video: normalize video pixel values by dividing by 255.0 for model input preprocessing
